reader.retry_policy: Only if the first output is not one complete positive ASCII integer or its confidence is below 0.8; at most two OCR calls on the same immutable card.
reader.unknown_policy: Unknown remains null; do not strip letters, substitute characters, join text fragments or treat unreadable quantities as zero.

geometry.coordinate_system: XYWH relative to a fully visible 84x84 RGB commodity card
geometry.reason: Tighten the vertical band to exclude commodity artwork while preserving the full horizontal text area for longer quantities.

scope: Quantity image reader only; no capture, click, warehouse task registration or game input.
limits: Both crop rectangles and the retry rule were calibrated on the same supplied screenshots, not independent live observations.
Real stack quantity fixtures contain 1..7 and 20; other values and longer quantities still require live layout observation.
Recognition uses the injected existing OCR service and preserves its raw text and confidence. No model or production OCR setting is changed.
Read only fully visible cards. After game input or a transition the caller must provide a fresh frame.
